text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—They are finally entering the third corner!
Who will make the first move from here?!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (I'll throw it all at them...! Everything I've got...!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio is making her move!
Here comes Tokai Teio!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama is trembling! The Arima Kinen!!
Tokai Teio! Tokai Teio!!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah, what what what is going on—!?
Nature, and Tannhauser too!?
Hey, you're kinda heavy~~!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Aargh, just let me celebrate properly for once today!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(Teio-san.
You truly are... an incredible Umamusume.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(Being able to witness your revival on this turf today...
I'm truly, so glad—)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you
for running with me today.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It was truly an honor
to run alongside you today.

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...! Teio...!
I'm so glad...! That was amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Teioooo!!
You were so super cool--!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. I certainly cannot
remain in such a disgraceful state forever—

Cheers praising Tokai Teio
echo through Nakayama Racecourse.

Though she had missed out on victory,
Ikuno Dictus's expression was one
of deep fulfillment—
